description.value: Taste of Super Kings is a South Surrey restaurant bringing together both North and South Indian cuisines under one roof, with a menu spanning crispy dosas and uttapams, fragrant biryanis, sizzling tandoori dishes, and rich curries. Founded by Indian-born owners who relocated to British Columbia, the restaurant leans into regional authenticity and offers dine-in, takeaway, and delivery. The spacious dining room is suited for large groups and the business also provides catering services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active, open dine-in Indian restaurant at 2828 152 St Surrey, BC V4P 1G6 with phone 604-440-3828. The website explicitly lists takeaway/delivery alongside dine-in, and the online shop menu clearly shows numerous vegetarian items (Veg Samosa, Veg Meal Box, Gobi Manchurian, dosas, idly, etc.). No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water refill information appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields default to null.
concerns: OSM record includes addr:unit 105 but the website address omits the unit number; minor discrepancy, likely same location.
About page contains the phrase 'Visit our Brampton location', suggesting a second location in Brampton, Ontario; the Surrey listing appears to be its own distinct operation.
OSM phone field is empty; phone number sourced from website only, so phone contact_confirmed is null rather than true.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Indian restaurant in South Surrey with a live website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down or takeaway meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Veg Samosa, Veg Pakora, Gobi Manchurian, Gobi 65, Veg Meal Box, Aloo Paratha, Idly, Plain Dosa, Masala Dosa, and Mysore Dosa, among other vegetarian South Indian items
